leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a child component that exposes custom methods using forwardRef and useImperativeHandle
Configure a parent component to access the child's imperative methods via a template reference
Initialize and manipulate component state that triggers imperative child behaviors
Construct a TypeScript interface defining the exposed imperative handle contract
Bind UI events in the parent component to execute child component methods imperatively
Control child component functionality from the parent without relying on props or events
Integrate useImperativeHandle with Angular's lifecycle hooks for proper initialization
